savollar.q: Never in my life ___ such an extraordinary performance.
savollar.izoh: Never bosh gapda kelsa inversiya: have I witnessed.

savollar.q: Not only ___ the exam, but she also earned the highest score.
savollar.izoh: Not only'dan keyin inversiya: did she pass.

savollar.q: Hardly ___ down when the doorbell rang.
savollar.izoh: Hardly had I ... when konstruksiyasi.

savollar.q: No sooner ___ the plane than a storm broke out.
savollar.izoh: No sooner had ... than.

savollar.q: Little ___ how difficult the journey would become.
savollar.izoh: Little did they suspect — kutilmagan holat.

savollar.q: Rarely ___ a novel that captivates me from the very first page.
savollar.izoh: Rarely bilan inversiya.

savollar.q: Seldom ___ such generosity from a complete stranger.
savollar.izoh: Seldom + present perfect inversiya.

savollar.q: Under no circumstances ___ the building during a fire drill.
savollar.izoh: Under no circumstances + inversiya.

savollar.q: Only after reading the contract twice ___ the hidden clause.
savollar.izoh: Only after ... did I notice.

savollar.q: Only then ___ the gravity of the situation.
savollar.izoh: Only then + inversiya.

savollar.q: Not until the results were published ___ the truth.
savollar.izoh: Not until ... did we learn.

savollar.q: Only by working together ___ overcome this crisis.
savollar.izoh: Only by ... can we.

savollar.q: Only when the sun set ___ how late it was.
savollar.izoh: Only when ... did they realize.

savollar.q: On no account ___ leave the premises without permission.
savollar.izoh: On no account + inversiya.

savollar.q: At no time ___ aware of the danger they were in.
savollar.izoh: At no time + inversiya (were they).

savollar.q: Nowhere ___ find a more loyal friend than him.
savollar.izoh: Nowhere + inversiya.

savollar.q: Not once ___ to help without being asked.
savollar.izoh: Not once + did he offer.

savollar.q: In no way ___ responsible for the damage caused.
savollar.izoh: In no way are we responsible.

savollar.q: Scarcely ___ the letter when she burst into tears.
savollar.izoh: Scarcely had ... when.

savollar.q: Barely ___ the finish line when he collapsed from exhaustion.
savollar.izoh: Barely had ... when.

savollar.q: ___ I known you were coming, I would have prepared dinner.
savollar.izoh: Had I known = If I had known.

savollar.q: ___ we had more resources, the outcome might have been different.
savollar.izoh: Had we had — shartli inversiya.

savollar.q: ___ I to accept the offer, I would relocate immediately.
savollar.izoh: Were I to accept = If I were to accept.

savollar.q: ___ she more experienced, she would handle the pressure better.
savollar.izoh: Were she more experienced = If she were.

savollar.q: ___ you require further assistance, do not hesitate to ask.
savollar.izoh: Should you require = If you should require.

savollar.q: ___ it not been for your support, we would have failed.
savollar.izoh: Had it not been for = If it had not been for.

savollar.q: ___ it not for the rain, the match would continue.
savollar.izoh: Were it not for = If it were not for.

savollar.q: ___ there be any objections, please raise them now.
savollar.izoh: Should there be = If there should be.

savollar.q: Choose the grammatically correct sentence.
v: Not only did he lie, but he also stole.
Not only he lied, but he also stole.
Not only lied he, but he also stole.
Not only he did lie, but he also stole.
savollar.izoh: Not only'dan keyin: did he lie.

savollar.q: Choose the correct sentence.
v: No sooner I arrived than it started to rain.
No sooner arrived I than it started to rain.
No sooner had I arrived than it started to rain.
No sooner I had arrived than it started to rain.
savollar.izoh: No sooner had I ... than.

savollar.q: Rewrite with inversion: 'She had rarely felt so nervous.'
v: Rarely had she felt so nervous.
Rarely she had felt so nervous.
Rarely did she feel so nervous.
savollar.izoh: Past perfect saqlanadi: Rarely had she felt.

savollar.q: Rewrite with inversion: 'I have never eaten such delicious food.'
v: Never I have eaten such delicious food.
Never have I eaten such delicious food.
Never did I eat such delicious food.
Never ate I such delicious food.
savollar.izoh: Present perfect: Never have I eaten.

savollar.q: Rewrite with inversion: 'If you had asked, I would have helped.'
v: Had you ask, I would have helped.
Did you ask, I would have helped.
Had you asked, I would have helped.
Were you asked, I would have helped.
savollar.izoh: If you had asked = Had you asked.

savollar.q: Not only ___ the funding cut, but the staff were also dismissed.
savollar.izoh: Not only was the funding cut — passiv bilan inversiya.

savollar.q: So ___ was the lecture that half the audience fell asleep.
savollar.izoh: So + sifat + inversiya: So boring was.

savollar.q: So ___ did she run that no one could catch her.
savollar.izoh: So fast did she run — inversiya.

savollar.q: Such ___ his anger that he could barely speak.
savollar.izoh: Such was his anger — inversiya.

savollar.q: Only after much deliberation ___ to resign.
savollar.izoh: Only after ... did she decide.

savollar.q: Never before ___ the city so crowded as during the festival.
savollar.izoh: Never before had we seen.

savollar.q: Not a single word ___ during the entire meeting.
savollar.izoh: Not a single word did he utter.

savollar.q: Only in retrospect ___ the wisdom of her advice.
savollar.izoh: Only in retrospect did I appreciate.

savollar.q: Never again ___ to take his freedom for granted.
savollar.izoh: Never again would he.

savollar.q: Hardly ever ___ to visit his elderly parents.
savollar.izoh: Hardly ever + inversiya.

savollar.q: Not since childhood ___ so carefree and happy.
savollar.izoh: Not since childhood had I felt.

savollar.q: Should you ___ your mind, the offer still stands.
savollar.izoh: Should you change = If you change.

savollar.q: Were the negotiations ___, both sides would benefit.
savollar.izoh: Were ... to succeed = If they were to succeed.

savollar.q: Had the doctor arrived sooner, the patient ___.
savollar.izoh: Had ... arrived, might have survived.

savollar.q: Only through hard work ___ achieve your dreams.
savollar.izoh: Only through hard work can you.

savollar.q: Not until he lost everything ___ what truly mattered.
savollar.izoh: Not until ... did he understand.

savollar.q: So ___ were the conditions that the expedition was cancelled.
savollar.izoh: So severe were the conditions — sifat.

savollar.q: Which sentence uses inversion correctly?
v: Little we did know what awaited us.
Little knew we what awaited us.
Little did we know what awaited us.
Little we knew what awaited us.
savollar.izoh: Little did we know.

savollar.q: Which sentence is correct?
v: Seldom does she complain about anything.
Seldom she does complain about anything.
savollar.izoh: Seldom does she complain.

savollar.q: Which sentence is correct?
v: Under no circumstances I will lie for you.
Under no circumstances will I lie for you.
Under no circumstances lie I will for you.
Under no circumstances I lie will for you.
savollar.izoh: Under no circumstances will I.

savollar.q: Which sentence is correct?
v: Not only the food was cold, but it was also stale.
Not only cold was the food, but it was also stale.
Not only the food cold was, but it was also stale.
Not only was the food cold, but it was also stale.
savollar.izoh: Not only was the food cold.

savollar.q: Rewrite: 'The moment I closed my eyes, I fell asleep.' (No sooner)
v: No sooner had I closed my eyes than I fell asleep.
No sooner I closed my eyes than I fell asleep.
No sooner did I close my eyes when I fell asleep.
No sooner had I closed my eyes when I fell asleep.
savollar.izoh: No sooner had ... than (when emas).

savollar.q: Rewrite: 'As soon as she left, the phone rang.' (Hardly)
v: Hardly she had left when the phone rang.
Hardly had she left when the phone rang.
Hardly had she left than the phone rang.
Hardly did she leave when the phone rang.
savollar.izoh: Hardly had ... when (than emas).

savollar.q: Only if you sign the form ___ your request.
savollar.izoh: Only if ... can we process.

savollar.q: Nowhere in the world ___ a beach as pristine as this one.
savollar.izoh: Nowhere ... will you find.

savollar.q: Little ___ that the decision would haunt her for years.
savollar.izoh: Little did she imagine.

savollar.q: Not for a moment ___ that he would betray us.
savollar.izoh: Not for a moment did we believe.

savollar.q: Rarely ___ a scientist so willing to admit uncertainty.
savollar.izoh: Rarely do you meet.

savollar.q: Only recently ___ the true value of that painting.
savollar.izoh: Only recently have experts recognized.

savollar.q: Were I ___ to advise you, I would recommend patience.
savollar.izoh: Were I asked = If I were asked.

savollar.q: Should anyone ___ about the incident, refer them to me.
savollar.izoh: Should anyone inquire = If anyone inquires.

savollar.q: Had they ___ the warning signs, the accident could have been avoided.
savollar.izoh: Had they heeded — past participle.

savollar.q: So ___ was her argument that no one could refute it.
savollar.izoh: So compelling was — sifat.

savollar.q: Such ___ the demand that tickets sold out in minutes.
savollar.izoh: Such was the demand.

savollar.q: Only after the storm passed ___ to assess the damage.
savollar.izoh: Only after ... were we able.

savollar.q: At no point ___ they consider surrendering.
savollar.izoh: At no point did they consider.

savollar.q: In no other country ___ such hospitality.
savollar.izoh: In no other country have I found.

savollar.q: Only with great effort ___ to lift the fallen tree.
savollar.izoh: Only with great effort did they manage.

savollar.q: Never ___ I imagined that success would feel so hollow.
savollar.izoh: Never had I imagined — past perfect.

savollar.q: Not until midnight ___ the guests finally leave.
savollar.izoh: Not until midnight did the guests leave.

savollar.q: Rarely ___ we witnessed such courage under fire.
savollar.izoh: Rarely have we witnessed.

savollar.q: Should the situation ___, we will evacuate immediately.
savollar.izoh: Should ... deteriorate = If it should deteriorate.

savollar.q: Little ___ we appreciate how fortunate we were.
savollar.izoh: Little did we appreciate.

savollar.q: Seldom ___ a leader shown such humility.
savollar.izoh: Seldom has a leader shown.

savollar.q: No sooner ___ the results announced than protests erupted.
savollar.izoh: No sooner were the results announced than.

savollar.q: Hardly ___ the ink dried when he regretted signing.
savollar.izoh: Hardly had the ink dried when.

savollar.q: Under no circumstances ___ passengers permitted beyond this point.
savollar.izoh: Under no circumstances are passengers permitted.

savollar.q: Which is correct?
v: Were it not for his help, we would be lost.
Was it not for his help, we would be lost.
Were not it for his help, we would be lost.
If were it not for his help, we would be lost.
savollar.izoh: Were it not for = If it were not for.

savollar.q: Which is correct?
v: Had not it been for the delay, we'd have made it.
Had it not been for the delay, we'd have made it.
Has it not been for the delay, we'd have made it.
Have it not been for the delay, we'd have made it.
savollar.izoh: Had it not been for.

savollar.q: Rewrite: 'If she should call, tell her I'm out.'
v: Should she call, tell her I'm out.
Should she calls, tell her I'm out.
Would she call, tell her I'm out.
Were she call, tell her I'm out.
savollar.izoh: Should she call — inversiya.

savollar.q: Rewrite: 'It was such a loud noise that everyone jumped.'
v: So was the noise that everyone jumped.
Such the noise was that everyone jumped.
Such was the noise that everyone jumped.
Such loud was the noise that everyone jumped.
savollar.izoh: Such was the noise.

savollar.q: Only by remaining calm ___ the crisis.
savollar.izoh: Only by ... did she survive.

savollar.q: Not since the war ___ the nation faced such hardship.
savollar.izoh: Not since the war has the nation faced.

savollar.q: So ___ did the hours pass that we lost track of time.
savollar.izoh: So quickly did the hours pass — ravish.

savollar.q: Were you ___ reconsider, we would welcome you back.
savollar.izoh: Were you to reconsider = If you were to.

savollar.q: Only when all else fails ___ to drastic measures.
savollar.izoh: Only when ... should we resort.

savollar.q: Never ___ a truer word been spoken.
savollar.izoh: Never has a truer word been spoken.

savollar.q: Rarely ___ such enthusiasm been shown by the students.
savollar.izoh: Rarely has such enthusiasm been shown.

savollar.q: Little ___ the audience know the show was improvised.
savollar.izoh: Little did the audience know.

savollar.q: Only after years of practice ___ to master the instrument.
savollar.izoh: Only after ... did he begin.

savollar.q: No sooner ___ we sat down than the waiter appeared.
savollar.izoh: No sooner had we sat down than.

savollar.q: Scarcely ___ the meeting begun when the alarm sounded.
savollar.izoh: Scarcely had the meeting begun when.

savollar.q: Under no circumstances ___ you disclose confidential data.
savollar.izoh: Under no circumstances must you disclose.

savollar.q: Only then ___ it dawn on me that I had been deceived.
savollar.izoh: Only then did it dawn on me.

savollar.q: Not until she spoke ___ recognize her voice.
savollar.izoh: Not until she spoke did I recognize.

savollar.q: Were I ___ choose again, I would follow the same path.
savollar.izoh: Were I to choose = If I were to.

savollar.q: Should any problems ___, our team will resolve them promptly.
savollar.izoh: Should any problems arise = If any should arise.
